name: cropshield-ai-website
description: Public website for CropShield AI. High-level field briefs only.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true}); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('.')) { if (['public','node_modules','.git','.vercel'].includes(f)) continue; if (fs.statSync(f).isFile()) fs.copyFileSync(f,'public/'+f); }"
